unexpressed.reason: subject is a list of six lesion classes ('secretion, junctions, proteostasis, replicative reserve, immune set point, tension') and the object 'failed repair of repetitive distal lung injury' fits no term; of the citations, PMID:27630174 only hypothesises MUC5B excess impedes repair, PMID:24050627 is a general review, R-HSA-5683826 is a surfactant-metabolism enrichment

H1.note: the chain ends at pulmonary fibrosis, not IPF; it is two arms (variant -> MUC5B -> ER stress, DSP -> EMT) joined only by H1.4's compound subject; the DSP sign is from the mechanism: 'loss or dysregulation of DSP-anchored junctions ... permits EMT and profibrotic signalling'

H2.note: TERT sign from 'Rare TERT loss-of-function alleles shorten telomeres and remove the replicative reserve'; SFTPC arm starts at BRICHOS-mutant pro-SFTPC; both arms are said to converge on AT2 senescence, but no step reaches it

H3.note: title rules out baseline susceptibility; mechanism says reduced TOLLIP function disinhibits innate signalling and impairs aggregate clearance, so TOLLIP genotype modulates disease course (mortality)

H4.no_claim_reason: FAM13A is said to set 'the amplitude of the fibrotic or emphysematous response', a modifier with no stated direction on IPF

H5.no_claim_reason: says the genes do not form a module; each lesion raises the chance injury resolves as fibrosis, but no gene-level direction (gain or loss) is given

findings.detail: H1.1 ends at 'MUC5B mucin' (protein), H1.2 starts at 'ectopic MUC5B expression' (process); same node, different labels and kinds; merged as MUC5B

H1.2 ends at ER stress and H1.3 starts at DSP; the chain is two parallel arms joined only by H1.4's compound subject, and no step links MUC5B to DSP although the mechanism calls them 'one lesion' and the falsification expects MUC5B knockdown to restore junctional programmes
'EMT and ER stress in distal airway epithelium' is two subjects; split into H1_4emt and H1_4er
H1 concludes at pulmonary fibrosis while the question is IPF, so its arms cannot be compared with the IPF claims of H2 and H3

PMID:21506741 reports MUC5B expression by disease status (14.1x in IPF), not by rs35705950 genotype; the variant-to-expression link is stated only by the review PMID:27630174 ('gain-of-function') and by PMID:41091081, which the run cited at H1.2
the H1.1 note says no record shows direct cellular causality, yet PMID:41091081 (cited at H1.2) reports ectopic MUC5B in AT2 cells of risk-variant controls and an in vitro MUC5B-ER stress link
PMID:18635891 (ER stress in AT2 cells of sporadic IPF) never mentions MUC5B; it states ER stress -> fibrosis and was moved to H1.4
UniProt P15924 says nothing about EMT or Hippo/YAP; the DSP -> EMT direction rests on one 2026 paper (PMID:42120512, 0 citations) where DSP loss is inferred from SYISL-driven degradation
PMID:24050627 is a general pathogenesis review naming neither EMT nor ER stress

PMID:41090357 blocks only IRE1a's RIDD output (keeping adaptive XBP1 splicing) and protects mice; it supports one branch of the ER stress response driving fibrosis, not ER stress at large, and BioLean has no way to mark that grain gap on kept evidence

H2.1 ends at 'telomere maintenance' (process), H2.2 starts at 'short telomere length' (phenotype); no definition or cited text gives a signed link (GO:0000723 includes processes that shorten telomeres), so the TERT claim has no route; UniProt O14746 does say TERT's main activity is elongation of telomeres, which would have connected had H2.1 targeted telomere length
H2.2 ends at IPF and H2.3 restarts at mutant pro-SFTPC; the H2 chain is two arms laid end to end

H2.3 ends at AT2 ER stress, H2.4 starts at AT2 senescence; no step links them, so the convergence on 'the same AT2 proteostasis/senescence failure' in the title has no link and the SFTPC claim has no route

none of the three citations states mutant pro-SFTPC -> ER stress: a Reactome enrichment for 'Defective pro-SFTPC causes SMDP2 and RDS', the SFTPC UniProt function (surface tension), and an IPF ER stress paper with no SFTPC; the run's own note concedes it

the run's H2.3 subject 'mutant pro-SFTPC (BRICHOS)' has no CURIE and denotes a class of SFTPC BRICHOS-domain variants with no single database ID; grounded with a BLN placeholder (BLN:SFTPC-BRICHOS-mutant), which the guide's entity table requires be recorded as a finding

PMID:32678092 and PMID:32661339 show senescence-featured transitional cells (Krt8+, PATS) persisting in fibrosis, an association in transitional cells rather than AT2; only the 2026 review PMID:42346293 states senescent alveolar epithelial cells drive fibrotic remodelling
PMID:42587125 (telomeric DDR inhibition reduces fibrosis in telomerase-knockout mice) bears on the TERT/telomere arm, not on AT2 senescence; the run cited it at the senescence step
PMID:23535734 gives the short-telomere-raises-risk direction only for coronary artery disease; for IPF it says only that TERC and TERT lead SNPs associate
STRING:GO:0000723 is a set enrichment ('6 of 97' genes) that names no gene; it cannot support TERT -> telomere maintenance

'AT2 senescence / failed alveolar regeneration' and 'IRAK1 phosphorylation / IL-1R-TLR signalling' join two nodes with a slash; each was curated as one node (at2Senescence; IRAK1 activity with the pathway as context)

H3.1-H3.2 are about TOLLIP protein function, H3.3 about TOLLIP variants; no step says the variants lower TOLLIP, though PMID:24429156 (cited at H3.3) states minor alleles cut TOLLIP expression by 20-50%; the H3 claim has no route

the run's 'unknown' polarity hides that rs5743890's minor allele is protective for susceptibility but raises mortality (HR 1.72) and lowers TOLLIP expression; the mortality half fits the H3 claim (less TOLLIP, worse course), the susceptibility half cuts against a simple TOLLIP-protects reading
PMID:23583980 does not name TOLLIP

the mechanism cites 'the pharmacogenetic interaction between TOLLIP genotype and N-acetylcysteine in the PANTHER trial population', but the only cited trial text reports the combination arm's harm, nothing on NAC alone or genotype
FAM13A -> RhoA inhibition rests on a domain annotation (O94988 has no function statement) and a review that says only 'modulation of Rho'; the run's note concedes it
PMID:29066090 and PMID:31710517 do not name FAM13A at all; PMID:23583980 lists FAM13A as a new locus without an allele or direction
PMID:42266412 (cited at H4.1) says FAM13A is 'linked to mitigated fibrotic remodeling in PF', a direction on fibrosis that H4 never uses; H4 makes no directional claim
object joins 'UIP pattern in systemic sclerosis ILD' and 'emphysema/CPFE'; the emphysema half rests only on a STRING co-citation record
the run types 'ectopic MUC5B expression' and 'RhoA activity' as processes and the variant as 'other'; BioLean puts expression and activity in the target (amount, activity) of a protein
'independent epithelial lesions (...)' and 'failed repair of repetitive distal lung injury' fit no term
four steps are associations; three have no direction at all and one (H3.3) has opposite directions by aspect, none of which an effect can hold
'TOLLIP variants', 'FAM13A variants' and the six-gene list are sets; a BLN class would hide that the cited texts give directions for single member alleles only
a phenotype conditional on another disease (UIP pattern among SSc-ILD patients); ctx has no disease field, though the run's step context has disease_state
genotype-by-treatment effect modification (TOLLIP genotype changes NAC response)
H4's central claim is a modifier that sets response amplitude in either direction; an effect needs a sign, so H4 has no claim
no subsumption from IPF to pulmonary fibrosis: H1's arms reach pulmonary fibrosis and cannot count for or against an IPF claim

the run contrasts airway (H1) with alveolar (H2) ER stress; following the guide H1's qualifier was dropped (erStress) and H2's kept (at2ErStress), so the two ER stress nodes differ only by curator choice

PMID:41728098 is a meta-analysis of observational studies; the guide forces 'observational' for a signed association, and 'metaAnalysis' would overstate it, so there is no kind for pooled observational data
PMID:41091081 and PMID:42120512 mix human tissue, cells and mice in one abstract; one kind per citation cannot record which design backs the quoted span
two expressible steps have every citation excluded; they are kept as statements with empty evidence rather than as unexpressed, which the guide does not settle

audit.before: no finding recorded for the BLN:SFTPC-BRICHOS-mutant variant-class placeholder
audit.after: added a hypothesis-agent ungrounded_label finding for H2.3 noting the run gave no ID for the SFTPC BRICHOS-mutant variant class, grounded with a BLN placeholder
audit.reason: the guide's entity table requires 'plus a finding' whenever a BLN class-of-variants placeholder is minted; the curator created BLN:SFTPC-BRICHOS-mutant but recorded no such finding
